verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS team-inbox platform, so shipping an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no such CLI. It shows a REST API, an official MCP server and an in-app command bar (⌘/Ctrl+K). These are developer building blocks, a separate server capability and an adjacent in-app UI feature, not an official command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
